dedup.note: SWAP: the DEV 'Nano Banana 2.1: What Changes for Design, Editing, and Image Costs' pick was removed after fact-check. It read as near-advertorial: the author's own product ReelDance, a 'drafted with AI assistance' note, and a closing 'Try it on ReelDance' walkthrough. It was also mislabeled KeyShot. The Vercel Nano Banana 2.1 and FLUX 3 Gateway posts (c18) stay out. Nano Banana 2.1 is not carried by any other pick. Replacement: the DEV 'Does a design system change what a coding agent writes?' essay, checked against the 30-day history_digest. It has no history_match tag. Its nearest stories are InfoQ 'From Reusable to Regeneratable' (10-03), DESIGN.md (09-08) and 'Bringing Design Systems into Figma Make' (09-12). None of them is the same experiment or article, so the verdict is new. Other alternates were rejected. Builder.io WebMCP how-to is a tutorial on the WebMCP running story (Vercel 09-19) with no new release, so it is treated as a follow-up and dropped. Keysight ADS 2027 is a real release but is RF engineering, far from designers, and would be a second cad card. UX Collective gamification would make 3 workflow cards and a second UX Collective card. Cross-section reservations from the original pass still hold. Unity Spark and Google Playground go to games. Surface Ultra, Xreal Aura, Copilot Windows and RTX Spark go to gadgets. SynthID goes to movies. Also still dropped from the original pass: Formas.AI Cartesian (same launch as aecmag 10-05), the UX Collective Meta cute-agent piece (same as Fast Company Muse Charm 09-27) and Builder.io 'stop installing skills' (close to Vercel 'State of agent skills' 09-26). Outlets: The Verge, DEVELOP3D, DEV x2, UX Collective (4 distinct, cap 2 respected). Categories: workflow 2, cad 1, tokens 2. The second tokens card gets palette accent #0070f3.
